title: Boundaries of Groups and Kleinian Groups — Problem 102
exact_target: Does every braid group admit a properly discontinuous, cocompact action by isometries on a CAT(0) space?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 6200102 (AMR-061-0102). CC BY 4.0.
Thomas Haettel, Dawid Kielak and Petra Schwer, \emph{The 6-Strand Braid Group Is CAT(0)}, arXiv:1304.5990v2 (2016), Introduction, printed p. 1, and Section 2.4, Definitions 2.27 and 2.29, p. 9.
